record_type: retrospective development selection; not a preregistration or heldout evaluation
decision: freeze one explicit-conjunction candidate for subsequent independent diagnostics and regression validation

candidate_semantics.ranking: preserve original top result; reserve each clause leader from the already scoped exact/stem candidate union; retain the remaining order
candidate_semantics.bounds_note: Only the candidate union is bounded. +rowid IN prevents repeated per-rowid MATCH, but FTS can scan matches outside the supplied scopes before filtering to the already scoped integer IDs.
candidate_semantics.source_preservation: ranking only; original source bodies, page identities and excerpt/source-span checks retained

development_inputs_only: pinned LoCoMo development hash-order first 128 eligible queries
selection_process.observed_selection_outcome: Zero per-query complete or evidence losses across both development cohorts at every measured budget; two additional complete synthetic questions at every budget.
limitations: Syntax heuristics may split a single concept or omit a shared qualifier from a later clause.
The full-query candidate cutoff can still omit necessary evidence.
These development observations do not establish generalization or answer quality.
The extra clause queries add retrieval work and measured tail latency.

query_plan_repair.defect: rowid IN causes SQLite FTS5 to use rowid equality plus MATCH repeatedly across the IN-list
query_plan_repair.change: AND rowid IN (...) -> AND +rowid IN (...) with the same bound integer IDs, ranking, filters and LIMIT

microcheck.scope: diagnostic example, two observations, not a general performance guarantee

provenance.evidence_metric: complete annotated utterance text and original source span
provenance.indexing: one dialogue utterance per canonical user-role turn; speaker prefix; text only
provenance.date_time_convention: source local clock represented as UTC for deterministic ordering

timing_limits: Single-repeat development observations. Core recall excludes tokenizer/packing, ingestion, MCP, networking and model inference. SQLite/OS caches are warm. Initial slow run overlapped briefly with correctness tests; do not use it as a controlled timing result. Corrected runs were sequential.
